name: Dungeon Finder offers Road to De Other Side on every tier and keeps Vaults of the Inquisition closed
contract: Road to De Other Side (map 937, LFGDungeons 402, 1402, 2402) has spawns, Dungeon Finder entrances and DestinyWeaver level scaling on Normal (band 15-59) and keeps no `disables` row of type 2 (DISABLE_TYPE_MAP) or type 8 (DISABLE_TYPE_LFG_MAP), so LFGMgr::IsDungeonDisabled reads every tier as enabled: a level 20 player can queue for its Normal tier, and the level 60 Heroic tier locks that player by level (LFG_LOCKSTATUS_TOO_LOW_LEVEL, 2). Vaults of the Inquisition (map 936, LFGDungeons 401, 1401, 2401) is closed by type 2 and type 8 rows with flags 7 (Normal, Heroic and Mythic, its three MapDifficulty rows; DisableMgr skips flags 15 as invalid), so every tier is disabled and LFGMgr::InitializeLockedDungeons gives it LFG_LOCKSTATUS_RAID_LOCKED (6) before any level check. LFGMgr::GetCompatibleDungeons drops a locked dungeon that IsDungeonDisabled reports, so the random finder cannot pick Vaults either.
